extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue.
